manifest_plan: Validate E2 Git/bridge raw identity; nofollow source dirs, exact bounded lstat only signed paths; reject symlink/hardlink/extra path; bind source namespace/dev and new transaction. Preserve protected data until actual owner permission.
owner_required_fields: E2 signing owner and immutable published Git commit
exact absolute source root and normalized relative file/directory paths
known full SHA and provenance, or exact permission for bounded fresh SHA
explicit COLD status, current/future-reader retirement and required retention/recovery
owner consent distinguishes archive preparation from exact post-restore source release
restore_plan: True164 durable whole archive + fresh ABSENT qualified native restore, full per-file SHA/size/uid/gid/mode/mtime_ns and every directory; persist exact proofs to true164+Git; no tmpfs as durable archive.
source_release: SOURCE_KEEP. Requires exact NEW transaction complete restore proofs AND E2 explicit owner consent AND independently authorized release resources, current readers, qualified INTENT/DONE journal and measured df. Target receipt alone never authorizes source delete.
transfer_plan: Independent target reservation/lease after P9 releases bridge; no Source tar or full staging; <=1MiB buffer, <=30MiB/s aggregate, <=128MiB exact chunks, <=256MiB bridge; stream source to bridge/true164; each batch resource/identity and current/future readers; no admission under P9 COPY5 or other24 controller.
